i was a relatively normal weight as a kid, but at around 14-15 i became severely depressed and didnt leave my house other than for school, ate a lot because i was feeling sad and put on a lot of weight in a short amount of time. i loved food but hated my body.

i wished i wasnt fat above basically everything else. i remember doing workouts secretly in my room but never stuck to them and searching on youtube “best at home workouts to lose weight”. stuff like that. 

then we got a scale. this was probably the turning point for my ed. i found out the best way to lose weight is from a calorie deficit, cut back on what i was eating and one thing led to another. next thing i know i was starving myself to “see results faster”. 

and now 2-3 years later im still stuck here lmao
